descriptionEn:
Question on § “Performing exercises on drawing up equations of chemical reactions” (Kimyo, grade 7).

Formulation: Choose the only correct option about “neutron”?

Correct answer: Electrically neutral particle of the nucleus of an atom.

Neutron n⁰ has no electrical charge.

Paragraph material (support for answer):

1. Drawing up chemical equations

2. Set the coefficients of chemical reactions.

3. 1) Fe+HCl→FeCl2 + H2 2) NH3→N2 + H2 3) Fe + Cl2→FeCl3 4) N2+O2 →NO 5) Mg+O2→MgO 6) H2+N2→NH3 7) CH4+O2→CO2 + H2O 8) Al+Cl2→AlCl3 9) Zn+O2→ZnO 10) P+O2→P2O5 2.

4. Using the algorithm for composing chemical reaction equations, create reaction equations between the following pairs of substances.

Remember: the answer must match the wording of the textbook. After choosing an option, check yourself again using the text §.
descriptionUz:
§ "Kimyoviy reaksiyalar tenglamalarini tuzish bo'yicha mashqlarni bajarish" bo'yicha savol (Kimyo, 7-sinf).

Formulyatsiya: "Neytron" haqida yagona to'g'ri variantni tanlang?

To'g'ri javob: Atom yadrosining elektr neytral zarrasi.

Neytron n⁰ elektr zaryadiga ega emas.

Paragraf materiali (javobni qo'llab-quvvatlash):

1. Kimyoviy tenglamalar tuzish

2. Kimyoviy reaksiyalar koeffitsientlarini belgilang.

3. 1) Fe+HCl→FeCl2 + H2 2) NH3→N2 + H2 3) Fe + Cl2→FeCl3 4) N2+O2 →NO 5) Mg+O2→MgO 6) H2+N2→NH3 7) CH4+O2→CO2 →Al → Al3) H2Cl+ Zn+O2→ZnO 10) P+O2→P2O5 2.

4. Kimyoviy reaksiya tenglamalarini tuzish algoritmidan foydalanib, quyidagi moddalar juftlari orasidagi reaksiya tenglamalarini tuzing.

Esingizda bo'lsin: javob darslik matniga mos kelishi kerak. Variantni tanlagandan so'ng, § matni yordamida o'zingizni yana tekshiring.
